# Release Notes

> A template for documenting project releases. Copy this file, rename it (e.g., `RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0.md`), and fill in the relevant details for each release.

---

## Version and Date

*Specify the release version (following [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/)) and the official release date.*

- **Version:** `vX.Y.Z`
- **Release Date:** `YYYY-MM-DD`
- **Release Type:** `Major | Minor | Patch`
- **Status:** `Stable | Beta | Release Candidate`

---

## Features

*List all new features, enhancements, and improvements introduced in this release. Include a short description and, where helpful, a reference to the related issue or pull request.*

- ✨ **[Feature Name]** — Brief description of the new feature and the value it provides to users. (#123)
- ✨ **[Feature Name]** — Brief description of another new feature. (#124)
- 🚀 **[Enhancement]** — Description of an improvement to an existing feature. (#125)

---

## Bug Fixes

*Document all resolved issues and defects. Reference the issue/PR number and briefly describe the fix.*

- 🐛 **[Component/Area]** — Fixed an issue where [describe the problem and how it was resolved]. (#201)
- 🐛 **[Component/Area]** — Resolved a crash that occurred when [describe scenario]. (#202)
- 🐛 **[Component/Area]** — Corrected unexpected behavior in [describe area]. (#203)

---

## Breaking Changes

*List any changes that are not backwards compatible. Include migration guidance so users can update their code or configuration accordingly.*

- ⚠️ **[API/Module Name]** — Description of the breaking change.
  - **Before:** `oldFunction(param)`
  - **After:** `newFunction(param, options)`
  - **Migration:** Step-by-step instructions for updating existing usage.
- ⚠️ **[Configuration]** — The `legacy_option` setting has been removed. Use `new_option` instead.

> **Note:** If there are no breaking changes in this release, replace this section with: _"No breaking changes in this release."_

---

## Acknowledgments

*Recognize and thank the contributors, maintainers, and community members who made this release possible.*

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who contributed to this release through code, reviews, testing, documentation, and feedback:

- [@contributor-handle](https://github.com/contributor-handle) — Brief description of contribution
- [@contributor-handle](https://github.com/contributor-handle) — Brief description of contribution
- [@contributor-handle](https://github.com/contributor-handle) — Brief description of contribution

Special thanks to our community for reporting issues, suggesting improvements, and helping shape the direction of this project. 💙

---

*For a complete list of changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/your-org/your-repo/compare/vX.Y.Z-1...vX.Y.Z).*
